rank: HOW TO: `.rank [@user]` renders your Direction A player card — avatar, tier pill (ROOKIE→LEGEND with stars), LEVEL/RANK/PROGRESS, XP bar with exact numbers, on your nitro banner if you have one. No argument = your card.
rewards: List every level → role reward on this server: `.rewards`.
rewardadd: Grant a role at a level: `.rewardadd <level> <@role>`. Members auto-receive it on level-up. Stacks unless `.stack` is off.
rewarddel: Remove a level reward: `.rewarddel <level>`. Already-granted roles stay.
xpmult: Set the server XP multiplier: `.xpmult <0-10>`. Events go brrr at 2x.
addxp: Give XP straight to a user: `.addxp @user <amount>`. Staff only. Useful for events and bribes.
noxp: Toggle XP gains on/off for a channel: `.noxp #channel`. Spam pits earn nothing.
lvlchannel: Pin where level-up announcements go: `.lvlchannel [#channel]`. No argument = current channel.
stack: Toggle whether level reward roles stack or replace each other: `.stack`.
vcpanel: Drop your room control panel into the room chat: `.vcpanel`. Lock, rename, kick from buttons.
ban: Ban a user from the server: `.ban @user [reason]`. Logged with reason; appeal in DMs (there is none).
unban: Unban a user by ID: `.unban <id>`. Check `.bans` for IDs.
kick: Kick a user off the server (can rejoin): `.kick @user [reason]`. For bans see `.ban`, for timed see `.tempban`.
mute: Timeout a user with the default duration: `.mute @user [time] [reason]` (time like `10m`, `2h`, `7d`). `.muteduration` sets the default, `.unmute` lifts.
tempban: Ban for a duration with auto-unban: `.tempban @user <duration> [reason]` (e.g. `7d`).
softban: Ban + instant unban in one move — kicks the user AND wipes their messages: `.softban @user [reason]`.
nick: Spend a 100k nick token to change your own nickname: `.nick <name>`. No token = no change.
warn: Issue a formal warning: `.warn @user [reason]`. Logged, counted, stacked toward punishment.
warnings: View every warning a user holds: `.warnings @user`.
clearwarns: Wipe a user's entire warn history: `.clearwarns @user`. Their slate is clean.
clear: Bulk delete messages: `.clear <amount>` (max 100, 14-day-old limit). Logged to mod-log.
slowmode: Set slowmode delay in the current channel: `.slowmode <seconds>` (0 = off).
lock: Lock the current channel (no one can talk): `.lock`. `.unlock` reopens.
antiraid: Raid shield: account-age gate, join-burst auto-lockdown, honeypot trap channel. `.antiraid status/toggle/...`.
automod: Content filter suite: `.automod status/toggle/badword-add/badword-remove/anti-invite/anti-link`. Strikes stack into timeouts.
banlist: Permanent bans that re-ban on rejoin: `.banlist add/remove/list`. Like permkick but for bans.
mod: Full moderation panel: warn/kick/ban/timeout in guided subcommands. `.mod <subcommand>`.
raid: Show the current antiraid config: `.raid`. Age gate, burst limits, action.
raction: What happens to too-new accounts: `.raction <kick|ban|log>`. Pairs with `.age` and `.raid`.
rburst: Join-burst lockdown threshold: `.rburst <joins> <seconds>` — that many joins that fast triggers lockdown.
lockdown: Raid emergency: lock/unlock ALL channels at once: `.lockdown`. Use when the raid is live.
honeypot: Trap channel: anyone who talks in it gets auto-banned. `.honeypot #channel` to arm, `.honeypot off` to disarm.
age: Minimum account age to stay (days): `.age <days>`. Younger accounts get flagged per `.raction`.
am: AutoMod status + quick usage: `.am [status]`. Covers spam, invites, links, bad words.
amtoggle: Master switch for AutoMod: `.amtoggle`. Everything sub-filter obeys it.
amword: Block or unblock a word: `.amword <add|del> <word>`. Blocked words earn strikes.
pban: Permaban by ID, forever, re-bans on sight: `.pban <id> [reason]`. `.punban` is the only exit.
punban: Lift a permaban AND unban: `.punban <id>`. Full pardon.
help: This help center: `.help` opens the module browser, `.help <command>` shows full detail + syntax + example for one command.
info: FAQ button panels with self-deleting answers: `.info setup` posts a panel, `.info add <panel> <label> [color] <answer>` adds a button. Members click, read, it vanishes.
infosetup: Post a fresh FAQ button panel: `.infosetup [#channel] | Title | text`. Then add buttons with `.infoadd`.
infoadd: Add a button with a private answer: `.infoadd <panel> | Label | text`. Full args skip the modal wizard.
inforem: Remove one button from a panel: `.inforem <panel> | Label`.
infodel: Delete a whole FAQ panel with all its buttons: `.infodel <panel>`. No undo.
infolist: List all FAQ panels with their buttons: `.infolist`.
rules: Rules panel with click-to-verify: `.rules setup` posts rules + verify button, `.rules edit` changes text, `.rulesoff` removes the panel.
rulesetup: Post rules + verify button: `.rulesetup #channel @role | Label | Title | text`. New members click to get the role.
rulesedit: Edit the rules panel in place: `.rulesedit | Label | Title | text`.
tttest: Manually check the latest video of an account: `.tttest <username>`.
rr: Post a self-role button row (up to 5 roles): `.rr @role1 @role2 ...`. Members click to take/drop. Manage Roles required.
tiktok: Ping a channel whenever a TikTok account posts: `.ttwatch <username> <#channel>`. `.ttlist` watched, `.tttest <username>` checks latest, `.ttunwatch <username>` stops.
ttwatch: Watch a TikTok account into a channel: `.ttwatch <username> <#channel>`. New posts ping the channel.
ttlist: List all watched TikTok accounts with their channels: `.ttlist`.
prefix: Change this server's command prefix: `.prefix <new>`. Default is `.`. Manage Server only.
profile: HOW TO: `.profile [@user]` (alias `.profil`) renders a Direction A player card — avatar, tier pill, STAFF badge for staff, LEVEL/RANK/PROGRESS, CASH/BANK/STREAK, JOB with fame title, TOP ROLE and XP bar, on your nitro banner. No argument = your own card.
setup: Full server checklist: staff roles, log channels, verify, welcome — `.setup` walks you through everything step by step.
staff: Register a staff role (passes every permission gate): `.staff @role`. `.stafflist` shows them.
setlog: Pin the mod-log channel: `.setlog #channel`. Bans, kicks, warns land here.
lang: Switch the bot language for this server: `.lang [en|pl]`. Everything (help included) flips.
wsetup: Set greeting channel + texts: `.wsetup #channel | join | leave`. Placeholders supported.
wtest: Preview the greeting texts without pinging anyone: `.wtest`.
leaderboard: XP standings, top 5 with cards: `.leaderboard` (aliases `.lb`, `.top`). Updates live as people grind.
muteduration: Set the server's default mute length: `.muteduration <time>` (e.g. `30m`). Used when `.mute` gets no time.
unmuteall: Remove ALL timeouts server-wide: `.unmuteall`. Mass forgiveness.
mutelist: Everyone currently timed out with time left: `.mutelist`.
imute: Block a user from posting images in THIS channel: `.imute @user [reason]`. `.iunmute` lifts it.
iunmute: Allow images again for a user here: `.iunmute @user`.
imutelist: Who is image-muted in this channel: `.imutelist`.
rmute: Block a user from adding reactions in THIS channel: `.rmute @user [reason]`. `.runmute` lifts it.
runmute: Allow reactions again for a user here: `.runmute @user`.
rmutelist: Who is reaction-muted in this channel: `.rmutelist`.
permkick: Kick plus automatic re-kick whenever they rejoin: `.permkick @user [reason]`. The endless boot. `.unpermkick` ends it.
unpermkick: Lift a permkick (or `all`): `.unpermkick @user|all`. They can stay after rejoin.
bans: List everyone currently banned: `.bans`. IDs included for `.unban`.
hackban: Ban a raw user ID without them being on the server: `.hackban <id> [reason]`. For pre-banning raiders.
unbanall: Unban EVERYONE at once: `.unbanall`. Think twice.
unwarn: Remove a user's latest warn: `.unwarn @user`. Forgiveness, one strike at a time.
hide: Hide the current channel from everyone (keeps staff): `.hide`. `.reveal` brings it back.
history: Full rap sheet: warns plus current timeout state: `.history @user`.
reason: Rewrite the reason of a user's latest warn: `.reason @user <text>`. For typos and second thoughts.
modstats: Warns handed out per moderator: `.modstats`. Know who swings the hammer most.
naughty: Most warned users ranking: `.naughty`. The wall of shame.
role: Give a role: `.role @user @role`. Higher-than-bot roles can't be granted.
stripstaff: Strip ALL roles from a user at once: `.stripstaff @user`. Nuclear option for rogue mods.
cleanup: Delete recent bot messages: `.cleanup [amount]`. For tidying after spammy commands.
forcenick: Lock a member's nickname for 1 hour: `.forcenick @user <name>`. Reverts automatically.
jail: Jail a user (they lose chat + economy access): `.jail @user [reason]`. `.unjail` frees, `.bail` is their 500-coin escape.
jailed: Who is currently jailed with time left: `.jailed`.
blind: Hide the current channel from one user: `.blind @user`. They won't see it exists. `.unblind` reverses.
unblind: Show the channel to the user again: `.unblind @user`. Undoes `.blind`.
drag: Drag a user into your voice channel: `.drag @user`. They must be in voice already.
newusers: Recently joined members: `.newusers [count]`. Spot raid accounts fast.
purge: Full purge suite: `.purge <amount>` nuke, plus filters (bots, links, images), log-channel ignore lists and per-channel setup. `.purge logs` manages log targets.
afk: Go AFK with an optional reason: `.afk [reason]`. Babka tells anyone who pings you why you're gone; talking again clears it.
avatar: Show someone's avatar in full size: `.avatar [@user]`. No argument = yours.
banner: Show someone's profile banner: `.banner [@user]`. Says so if they have none.
roblox: Roblox lookup: `.roblox user <name>` profile + created + friends, `.roblox avatar <name>` full-size avatar, `.roblox previousnames <name>` name history.
bal: Your wallet card: cash, bank and daily streak — with your nitro banner as background if you have one. `.bal [@user]` inspects anyone.
daily: Daily coins every 24h: `.daily`. Base 500 plus streak bonus (+50/day up to +500). Missing a day resets the streak — don't.
blackjack: HOW TO PLAY: `.blackjack <bet>` (max 15000). You vs dealer, closest to 21 wins. HIT takes a card, STAND holds, DOUBLE doubles the stake for one card. Dealer draws to 17, ties push. Blackjack pays 6:5, bust = bet lost, max profit 15k/hand. 10 plays/hour shared with other games. Bets accept 1k / 2.5k / 1m / all.
embed: Post and manage rich embeds: `.embed post #ch <title> | <text>`, `.embed edit <id> | <new>`, `.embed delete <id>`. Manage Server only.
giveaway: Timed draws: `.giveaway start` (follow the wizard: prize, winners, duration), enter with the button, `.giveaway end/reroll/cancel`, `.giveaway list` shows running ones.
poll: Button polls with live counts: `.poll create`, vote with buttons, `.poll results`, `.poll close`. Manage Server to run.
reactionroles: Emoji reaction roles: `.reactionroles setup` posts a panel, users tap emoji to take/drop roles. Full CRUD via subcommands.
welcome: Greetings, boost thanks and ping-on-join: `.welcome setup/test/disable`. New members feel seen.
tickets: Ticket system: typed panels, claim, transcripts, ratings, auto-close. `.tickets setup` starts the wizard.
vcs: Voice rooms in one shot: .vcs <lobby> <panel> creates everything. .vcs off disables.
verify: Verification gate (button or captcha): `.verify setup` wires it, members verify to get the role.
slots: HOW TO: `.slots <bet>` — three animated reels. Triple 7 = JACKPOT 12x, triple gem 5x, other triples 4x, any pair = 1.5x back. Anything else = bet lost. 10 plays/hour shared. Bets accept 1k / 2.5k / 1m / all.
coinflip: HOW TO PLAY: `.coinflip <bet> <heads|tails>` (alias `.moneta`, O = orzeł, R = reszka). Win = double back (profit = bet). House-favored odds. 10 plays/hour shared. Bets accept 1k / 2.5k / 1m / all.
roulette: HOW TO: `.roulette <bet> <choice>` on a real European wheel with animation. Choices: number 0-36 (pays 35:1), red/black, odd/even, high/low (1:1), dozens 1st12/2nd12/3rd12 and columns col1/col2/col3 (2:1). Recent numbers shown every spin. 10 plays/hour shared. Bets accept 1k / 2.5k / 1m / all.
rob: HOW TO: `.rob @user`. About 20% success — win steals a cut of their cash, fail = you pay a fine. Target must hold cash; bots and yourself excluded. 1 attempt/hour, jail wipes your plans.
rich: Top 10 fattest wallets on this server. Updated live — go touch grass instead.
pay: Send coins to someone: `.pay @user <amount>`. Minimum 10. No take-backs.
work: Run a paid shift at your current job: `.work`. 1 shift/hour. Pay scales with job, fame title, level and streak — promotions raise every bracket.
ship: Love compatibility % between two users, stored forever: `.ship @a [@b]` (no second user = you + them). `.shiplb` ranks couples.
shiplb: Top couples ranking — highest shipped pairs on the server.
fitleader: Hardest fits leaderboard — top rated outfits of the server.
clownleader: Hall of shame: members with the most clown moments. `.clownleader` shows the top.
clownwall: Clown wall setup: `.clownwall set #channel` to collect marked moments, `.clownwall off` to disable.
babka: Babka herself — summons a random piece of grandma wisdom (or a roast). Usage: `.babka`. No refunds.
wordle: Daily Polish 5-letter word: `.wordle <guess>`, 6 tries. Win = XP + cash, once per day. Bare `.wordle` shows today's board.
counting: Counting game: `.counting set #channel` — members count up one by one, no double turns, wrong number resets. `.counting off` disables.
voice-state: Who earns voice XP right now: `.voice-state` lists connected, unmuted members per channel.
party: No-limit party mode for your room: `.party`. User cap goes poof.
bring: Drag a whole role into your voice channel: `.bring @role`. Party herding tool.
whitelist: Channels exempt from automod and level limits: `.whitelist add/remove/list`. Spam pits go here.
strike-reset: Clear someone's bad-word strikes: `.strike-reset @user`. Clean mouth, clean slate.
youtube: YouTube upload pings: `.youtube watch <channel-id> <#channel>`, `.youtube list`, `.youtube unwatch`. New uploads get announced.
stats: Live server stat channels (members/boosts counters): `.stats setup` creates, `.stats refresh` updates.
langroles: Auto language roles + picker panel: `.langroles setup`. Members self-tag EN/PL.
job: HOW TO: `.job list` shows offers with click-to-join buttons (pay range, top title, level locks). `.job join <name>` hires you, `.job show [@user]` inspects a career, `.job leave` quits, `.job my` shows fame. Higher level = better titles and bigger pay. `.work` runs a paid shift every hour. Each evolution grants a matching Discord role that upgrades as you rank up.
shop: Two stores, one name: `.shop` = babka store (tokens, boosts, shields, boxes, curses, bail, VIP). `;shop` = pokemon item store, PokeMeow-style (`;shop buy <name|id> [n]`).
curse: Spend a curse scroll to strip someone's rob shield: `.curse @user`. Fails (free) if they hold no shield.
inv: Two bags, one name: `.inv` = babka stash (tokens, shields, scrolls). `;inv` = pokemon bag (same as `;items`).
bail: Buy your way out of jail for 40000 coins with `.bail` (or `.shop buy bail`). Fails if you're free or broke.
heist: HOW TO: `.heist start <target>` opens a crew robbery — everyone stakes in. `.heist join` before the timer ends. Bigger crew = better odds. Win splits the loot, fail = jail for the whole crew.
bounty: Put a price on someone's head: `.bounty @user <amount>`. Paid from your cash immediately, listed until someone claims it.
bounties: Board of open bounties with prices. Claim one by robbing the target successfully — the price lands in your wallet.
bank: Your vault card: balance plus interest that grows over time. Banked money can't be robbed. `.bank` to view, `.deposit` / `.withdraw` to move cash.
deposit: Move cash into your bank: `.deposit <amount|all>`. Banked money earns interest and can't be robbed.
withdraw: Take money out of your bank: `.withdraw <amount|all>`. Cash in hand can be robbed — don't flash it.
tribute: Tip Babka coins: `.tribute <amount>`. She remembers generosity — top tippers get her favor.
bankshare: Open a joint vault with another member: `.bankshare @user`. Both can deposit; closing it returns the money to where it was.
ecoreset: OWNER ONLY. Wipes everyone's money on this server. Repeat with `yes` to confirm: `.ecoreset yes`.
fitlink: Merge two accounts' fits into one profile: `.fitlink @user`. For alts and rebrands.
fitunlink: Split previously linked fits back apart: `.fitunlink`.
language: Alias of `.lang`: switch bot language EN/PL.
levels: Level system admin: XP rates, stacking, announcements. `.levels` shows subcommands.
nickbomb: Spend a scroll to rename someone else for 24 hours: `.nickbomb @user <name>`. Peak comedy weapon.
selfroles: Self-assignable roles panel: `.selfroles`. Members take what they want, mods keep control.
sr-add: Add a role to the selfroles panel: `.sr-add @role`.
suggest: Suggestions with voting boxes: `.suggest setup` wires server/bot inboxes, members submit, staff accept/deny with buttons.
poker: Video poker (Jacks or better). HOW TO PLAY: 1) bet — e.g. `.poker 100`. 2) You get 5 cards. 3) Press buttons 1-5 to HOLD the cards you keep (press again to unhold). 4) Press DRAW — held cards stay, the rest are swapped, once only. PAYS (profit x bet): pair of jacks or better 1x, two pair 2x, three of a kind 3x, straight 4x, flush 6x, full house 9x, four of a kind 25x, straight flush 50x, royal flush 250x. Anything less = bet lost. Shares the 10 plays/hour limit with other games. Bets accept 1k / 2.5k / 1m / all.
achievements: Auto-awarded badges (level, cash, shifts, fame). Shown on your profile card.
stocks: Fake stock exchange: 6 joke stocks, prices drift every 15 min + every view.
stockbuy: Buy shares with cash: .stockbuy <SYM> <cash>. Buys whole shares only.
stocksell: Sell shares for current price with P/L shown: .stocksell <SYM> <qty|all>.
portfolio: Your holdings with live value and P/L.
val: Valorant tracker: rank, RR, peak and last match for Name#Tag (needs free Henrik key).
starter: Pick your starter + 10 balls. One per trainer.
hunt: Spawn a wild encounter (60s cooldown). FIGHT it or THROW BALL.
catch: Throw a ball at your encounter. Weaker foes catch easier.
guess: Name a ??? silhouette to catch it FREE.
hint: Reveal half the letters of a mystery silhouette.
box: Your collection: species stacks, 10 per page.
mon: Full stats card of one pokemon: level, types, moves, XP.

release: Release for coins (rarity x level, shiny x5). Locked are safe.
releaseall: Release every matching species for coins. Skips locked.
balls: Pokemon item shop: balls, potions, candy, eggs, lures. Numbered rows — buy by name or ID via `;shop buy`. Also `;pokeshop` / `;shop pokemon`.
battle: Turn-based wild battle: 4 moves, potions, ball, run.
duel: Interactive team duel (up to 3v3) with wager. Accept to play.
sell: List a pokemon for cash (max 3, 5% fee).
buy: Buy a market listing by ID.
unlist: Take your listing back to the box.
buddy: Companion: bonus XP + hearts. Slot sets, text renames.
team: Your duel squad. Bare shows, slots set it.
candy: Feed a rare candy: instant +1 level.
hatch: Hatch a ready egg (warmed by catches).
swap: Wonder swap: lose yours, random new (1% shiny).
checklist: Daily trio: 5 catches / 3 battles / 1 duel. Claim the prize.
shinyhunt: Chain a species: odds 1/256 down to 1/32.
quests: Region catch tracks with cash tiers + Master badges.
npc: NPC ladder: joey/finn/cyntia, once a day each, cash + badge.
trainer: Your trainer card: box, levels, dex, duels.
emojisetup: Deploy Babka emoji fleet: preview, then confirm wipes + uploads 20 emojis per server.
pokemon: Full monster game on ; prefix: manual + chat auto-spawns, mystery guess-catching, buddy, teams, NPC ladder, trading, market, quests, checklist, shiny chains, eggs, codes.

items: Your pokemon bag: balls, potions, candy, incense, eggs.
evs: EV panel: what battles trained, caps and Power items.
held: Held items: equip, swap or drop one.
grazz: Feed a golden razz (3k in ball shop): way better catch odds.
code: Event codes: redeem cash/balls. House mints with create.
counter: Counter: how many mons you own.

voice: Join-to-create rooms with a full control panel in the room chat.
moderation: Bans, kicks, mutes, warns, purges, slowmode, locks.
protection: Age gate, raid lockdown, honeypot, filters, permabans. Slash only.
